turns.responseText:
ABL1 Kinase Pharmacophore Modeling & Library Screening — Builds a consensus pharmacophore from 4 known ABL1 inhibitors and screens a 4-compound library against it in a single run.

Input: 4 reference SMILES (Imatinib, Dasatinib, Bosutinib, Asciminib) as reference_smiles; 4 library SMILES (Gleevec-analog-1, Ponatinib, Terfenadine, Acetaminophen) as library_smiles; min_features = 3
Key steps:

RDKit MolVS + PharmacophoreModel → extracts shared H-bond donors/acceptors, hydrophobic centers, and aromatic rings from the 4 actives → consensus pharmacophore model (JSON + feature map)
Pharmacophore Screening Engine → scores each library compound against the consensus model, counting matched features (≥ min_features = 3 to pass)


Expected output: pharmacophore_hits.csv (compound ID, matched features, pass/fail flag) + pharmacophore_model.json (feature definitions) + ranked HTML screening report


✅ All 4 reference SMILES and all 4 library SMILES have been parsed and passed to the pharmacophore_filtering workflow. Click Run to execute — no additional input needed. Results will flag Gleevec-analog-1 and Ponatinib as likely hits (structurally similar to actives), while Terfenadine and Acetaminophen are expected to fail the ABL1 pharmacophore filter.
